project: KitchenOps — commercial kitchen inventory depletion and smart restock logistics

test_cases.title: Log in with the 4-digit code sent to e-mail
steps: Send POST request to /auth/code with JSON payload {"email": "chef@kitchenops.internal"}
Retrieve the 4-digit verification code sent to the email address
Send POST request to /auth/token with JSON payload {"email": "chef@kitchenops.internal", "code": "1234"}
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with JSON access_token; client successfully establishes session.

test_cases.title: A wrong login code is refused with an error message
test_cases.precondition: A 4-digit code has been requested for chef@kitchenops.internal
steps: Send POST request to /auth/token with JSON payload {"email": "chef@kitchenops.internal", "code": "0000"}
test_cases.expected: Server refuses the invalid code with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and returns an error detail.

test_cases.title: An expired login code is refused with an error message
test_cases.precondition: A 4-digit code was requested for chef@kitchenops.internal more than 10 minutes ago
steps: Simulate time expiration exceeding 10 minutes from code generation
Send POST request to /auth/token with JSON payload {"email": "chef@kitchenops.internal", "code": "1234"}
test_cases.expected: Server rejects the expired code with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and prompts for a new code request.

test_cases.title: An invalid email address format is refused with a 422 error
steps: Send POST request to /auth/code with malformed payload {"email": "invalid-email-format"}
test_cases.expected: Server rejects the request with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity indicating invalid email format.

test_cases.title: Requesting a second login code within 60 seconds is refused with 429 Too Many Requests
test_cases.precondition: A code was requested for chef@kitchenops.internal less than 60 seconds ago
steps: Send second POST request to /auth/code for chef@kitchenops.internal within the 60-second cooldown window
test_cases.expected: Server refuses the throttled request with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

test_cases.title: Querying current authenticated session profile returns user details or 401 when unauthorized
test_cases.precondition: Valid JWT bearer token obtained via /auth/token
steps: Send GET request to /auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <valid_token>
Send GET request to /auth/me without authorization header or with an invalid token
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with user profile for valid token, and HTTP 401 Unauthorized for missing/invalid token.

test_cases.title: Log 10 portions of Rigatoni Pomodoro to deplete raw ingredients
test_cases.precondition: Logged into KitchenOps with active bearer token
steps: Send POST request to /prep/portions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON {"recipe_id": "rigatoni_pomodoro", "portions": 10}
Send GET request to /inventory/levels with Authorization: Bearer <token>
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with audit transaction; pasta stock decreases by 1.2 kg and tomato sauce decreases by 0.8 kg.

test_cases.title: Submitting invalid portion count of zero is prevented
test_cases.precondition: Logged into KitchenOps with active bearer token
steps: Send POST request to /prep/portions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON {"recipe_id": "rigatoni_pomodoro", "portions": 0}
Send POST request to /prep/portions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON {"recipe_id": "rigatoni_pomodoro", "portions": -5}
test_cases.expected: Server rejects both invalid requests with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity without altering stock levels.

test_cases.title: Stock dropping below safety threshold generates automated supplier PO
test_cases.precondition: Cooking cream inventory is at 3.5 L, below the 5.0 L safety threshold
steps: Send GET request to /orders/replenish with Authorization: Bearer <token>
Send POST request to /orders/dispatch with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON {"order_id": "PO-2026-041"}
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with draft purchase order PO-2026-041 for 20.0 L cooking cream, and dispatches it successfully.

test_cases.title: Stock above safety threshold does not trigger unneeded purchase order
test_cases.precondition: Pasta inventory is healthy at 13.3 kg with safety threshold set to 5.0 kg
steps: Send GET request to /orders/replenish with Authorization: Bearer <token>
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with empty replenishment list, asserting no unnecessary purchase orders are triggered.

test_cases.title: Perishable batch expiring within 48 hours displays amber alert banner
test_cases.precondition: Cooking Cream batch #B-104 expires in 36 hours
steps: Open web/home.html in browser and inspect live inventory card status
Verify batch expiry indicators on active ingredient items
test_cases.expected: An amber alert box displays 'FIFO Alert (48h Spoilage Window): Lot #B-104 expires on Oct 14' with priority rotation label.

test_cases.title: Oldest unexpired batch is prioritized for recipe depletion over newer batch
test_cases.precondition: Pasta has two batches in storage: Lot #P-201 (arrived Oct 01) and Lot #P-208 (arrived Oct 10)
steps: Open web/prep.html with dish recipe Rigatoni Pomodoro selected
Inspect FIFO lot allocation preview before depletion confirmation
test_cases.expected: The preview explicitly attributes depletion to the older Lot #P-201 in accordance with FIFO rules.

test_cases.title: Record inbound wholesale delivery of 25kg flour into inventory
steps: Open receiving view, select All-Purpose Flour (25 kg bag)
Input quantity 25, batch LOT-FL-20261013, expiry 2027-04-15, and confirm
test_cases.expected: The inventory screen opens confirming the newly received flour batch is added to active stock.

test_cases.title: Every screen fits a mobile phone viewport 390 px wide
test_cases.precondition: Browser phone simulation view is set to 390 px width
steps: Navigate sequentially through web/login.html, web/home.html, web/prep.html, and web/order.html at 390px width
test_cases.expected: No screen displays horizontal scrollbars, text is fully legible, and interactive buttons are comfortably accessible.
